name: Isle of Pines Root Beer Cabin
status: Actual 5x4 native-source room is published with an empty interior, one outside Dorothy, passive Floor arrival3 and both working carpet returns. Native Root Beer item/gift/shop/rest and actual-location controller/Continue/audio preservation proofs pass. Conditional indoor relocation and Safari runtime remain pending.
coordinate_units: rows are 32px metatiles; actors, interactions and warps use zero-based 16px core tiles

authentic_recipes.name: back wall and native hanging picture
complete dining table and cushion recipe
wood serving counter with woven-mat customer strip

source_art_contract.stove: No authenticated stove exists in the inspected house/traditional_house recipes. Do not label INCENSE_BURNER or a radio as a stove; this room deliberately omits one.
source_art_contract.style: Small wood-lined hospitality cabin, complete table/seating to the west, pantry cupboards behind a narrow counter and clear two-core-tile customer aisle to the east. No invented pixels or oversized furniture.

warp_contract.both_exit_targets: The current exterior cabin door's separate safe-FLOOR return warp, never the active DOOR quadrant.
warp_contract.exterior_binding: Root/exterior author resolves BWS_ROOT_BEER_CABIN_DOOR from the current preserve layout; do not copy provisional coordinates into the publisher.
warp_contract.required_native_change: Append the passive third interior arrival record and point the exterior DOOR at it. The current generic single-mouth builder requires target_warp 1, so it cannot be used unchanged to promise a FLOOR arrival.
required_verification: both carpet exits return to exact exterior passive FLOOR
walking over either passive arrival does not warp
entry and exits do not bounce after Continue

dorothy_presence.rule: Dorothy is visibly outside in the ordinary preserve overview. Only an implemented cabin-entry scene may relocate that same logical person to the counter; suppress her outside appearance for that serving state. No second simultaneous Dorothy.
dorothy_presence.derivation: Derive intended presence from authoritative current map and service availability, using native map-entry/exit object commands. Do not add an unrelated permanent story flag or let an interrupted warp strand both appearances.
dorothy_presence.before_service_implementation: Keep the interior empty. The supplied serving portrait is a separately labeled future entry-scene preview, not an already working NPC.

service_counter.required_native_behavior: Use OverworldSession's actual counter interaction extension, not a label/event that pretends the counter is walkable.

hospitality_contract.backend: New typed Rust root-beer hospitality service shared by the outside and conditional indoor actor; do not register the string as if an existing service already implements it.

first_gift.commit: Set only after actual inventory delivery in the same successful transaction. Decline/full bag leaves the offer available. Inside and outside share the same flag.

purchase.commit: Native money/bag/shop flow with explicit confirmation; insufficient funds or full bag consumes nothing. A delivered bottle debits exactly 300 once.

native_shop_binding.required_registration: Register the new mart inventory and ROOT_BEER item in typed Rust before parsing these native commands. This is an unimplemented binding, not an existing shop.

consumption.preservation: Add a new item definition; leave LEMONADE, FRESH_WATER and all original native items unchanged.
consumption.verify: Actually target an injured party member through Pack, restore min(60, missing HP), consume one bottle and return input. Full HP/cancel must not consume it. Safari capture-only encounters still forbid ordinary battle items.

optional_nursing_rest.party_effect: Actual HP/status/PP restoration through the parsed native special, once service is implemented.
optional_nursing_rest.expedition_effect: Preserve active Safari phase, entry charge, balls, steps and encounter/reward state exactly; never call Safari initialization or replenish counters.

hospitality_contract.step_budget: Treat this cabin as an allowed interior of the active expedition. Actual native player movement inside still costs one successful transition under Safari travel accounting. Entering the door costs the successful movement once; the scripted safe arrival costs no extra transition. Dialogue, shop menus and nursing animation cost zero and never refill anything. Last-step expiration inside uses the same safe retirement policy.
hospitality_contract.story: Optional hospitality; neither gift, purchase nor rest grants Q07 or blocks early retirement/through-travel.
